units.title: 国朝·日辰拱扶子位，东宫摄天子之权（旧注：他宫子孙旺相又得日辰生扶、世值胎养空绝，主幼主在位、大臣摄政，如周公辅成王；本宫子孙生旺得日辰扶助，国君将传位，太子当国）

rule.yi: 别的宫的子孙旺相，又遇日辰生扶拱合，而世爻落在胎、养、空、绝上，主国君年幼，有大臣摄政，像周公辅佐成王；本宫的子孙生旺，又得日辰扶助，是国君厌倦了大位、想要传位，太子主持国政、代行天子的事。
rule.en: If the Output of another palace is thriving or strong and is further generated, supported or combined by the Day, while the Self falls on Womb, Nurture, Void or extinction, the ruler is young and a great minister acts as regent, like the Duke of Zhou assisting King Cheng; if the Output of the home palace is thriving and gets support from the Day, the ruler is tired of the great seat and wants to hand it on, and the crown prince takes charge of the state and acts in the Son of Heaven's stead.

zh: 日辰拱扶子位，东宫摄天子之权。
yi: 日辰拱扶子孙之位，东宫（太子）就代行天子的权力。
en: If the Day supports and holds up the place of Output, the Eastern Palace takes over the Son of Heaven's authority.

zh: 子孙乃臣位。
若他宫子孙旺相，更值日辰，生扶拱合，世值胎养空绝，必主少国，疑有大臣摄政。
如周公辅成王是。
若本宫子孙生旺，更得日辰扶助，必国君厌弃大宝，将欲传位；
太子当国，摄天子事也。
yi: 子孙是臣子的位置。
如果别的宫的子孙旺相，又逢日辰生、扶、拱、合，而世爻落在胎、养、空、绝上，必定是年幼的国君在位，大概有大臣摄政。
就像周公辅佐成王。
如果本宫的子孙生旺，又得到日辰扶助，必定是国君厌倦了帝位，想要传位；
太子主持国政，代行天子的事务。
en: Output is the ministers' place.

If the Output of another palace is thriving or strong and further meets the Day generating, supporting, holding up or combining with it, while the Self falls on Womb, Nurture, Void or extinction, the state surely has a young ruler, and a great minister is probably acting as regent.
The Duke of Zhou assisting King Cheng is an example.
If the Output of the home palace is thriving and gets support from the Day, the ruler is surely tired of the throne and wants to hand it on;
the crown prince takes charge of the state and acts for the Son of Heaven.

zh: 若本宫子孙生旺，更得日辰扶助，欲传位太子，当国摄天子事也。
yi: 如果本宫的子孙生旺，又得到日辰扶助，是想要传位给太子，太子主持国政，代行天子的事务。
en: If the Output of the home palace is thriving and gets support from the Day, the ruler wants to hand the throne to the crown prince, who takes charge of the state and acts for the Son of Heaven.

note.yi: 旧注把子孙分成别的宫的（臣子，幼主在位、大臣摄政）和本宫的（太子）两种；卜筮正宗只收了本宫子孙这一半。
note.en: The old commentary divides Output into that of another palace (the minister: a young ruler on the throne and a great minister as regent) and that of the home palace (the crown prince); the Bu Shi Zheng Zong keeps only the home palace half.

units.title: 国朝·世克福爻，唐玄宗有杀儿之事（旧注：本宫子孙被四爻冲克刑害，必被谗臣谤讪；世克本宫子孙而子孙又入死墓空绝，太子遇谗被害，如唐玄宗信李林甫之谮废杀太子瑛等）

rule.yi: 本宫的子孙（太子）被第四爻冲、克、刑、害，必定被进谗的臣子诽谤；世爻克本宫的子孙，子孙又落入死、墓、空、绝，太子遭谗言陷害，就像唐玄宗听信李林甫的谗言，把太子瑛、鄂王瑶、光王琚都废为平民，后来又赐死在城东驿。
rule.en: If the Output of the home palace (the crown prince) is clashed, controlled, punished or harmed by the fourth line, he is surely slandered by treacherous ministers; if the Self controls the Output of the home palace and that Output also falls into death, tomb, Void or extinction, the crown prince meets slander and is harmed, like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, who trusted Li Linfu's slander, demoted Crown Prince Ying, Prince E (Yao) and Prince Guang (Ju) to commoners and later granted them death at the Chengdong post station.

zh: 世克福爻，唐玄宗有杀儿之事；
yi: 世爻克福神，就像唐玄宗有杀儿子的事；
en: If the Self controls the Output line, it is like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang killing his sons;

zh: 若本宫子孙，被四爻冲克刑害，必被谗臣谤讪。
若世克本宫子孙，子孙又入死墓空绝，必太子遇谗被害。
如唐玄宗信李林甫谮，将太子瑛，鄂王瑶，光王琚，皆废为庶人，后复赐死于城东驿也。
yi: 如果本宫的子孙被第四爻冲、克、刑、害，必定被进谗的臣子诽谤讥讽。
如果世爻克本宫的子孙，子孙又落入死、墓、空、绝，必定是太子遭到谗言陷害。
就像唐玄宗听信李林甫的谗言，把太子瑛、鄂王瑶、光王琚都废为平民，后来又赐他们死在城东驿。
en: If the Output of the home palace is clashed, controlled, punished or harmed by the fourth line, he is surely slandered and mocked by treacherous ministers.
If the Self controls the Output of the home palace and that Output also falls into death, tomb, Void or extinction, the crown prince is surely harmed by slander.

It is like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang who believed Li Linfu's slander, demoted Crown Prince Ying, Prince E (Yao) and Prince Guang (Ju) all to commoners, and later granted them death at the Chengdong post station.

zh: 若世克本宫之墓绝子孙，太子遇谗被害，如唐玄宗信李林甫谱，将太子、英鄂五瑶、光王琚皆废，复赐死。
yi: 如果世爻克本宫落在墓、绝上的子孙，太子遭到谗言陷害，就像唐玄宗听信李林甫的谗言，把太子、瑛、鄂王瑶、光王琚都废掉，又赐他们死。
en: If the Self controls the Output of the home palace that is in tomb or extinction, the crown prince meets slander and is harmed, like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang who trusted Li Linfu's slander, deposed the crown prince, Ying, Prince E (Yao) and Prince Guang (Ju), and later granted them death.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗这一句有错字：「谮」写成了「谱」，「瑛、鄂王瑶」写成了「英鄂五瑶」；译文按旧注读。另外旧注有「四爻冲克刑害子孙」和「世克子孙」两种情形，卜筮正宗只收了后一种。
note.en: The Bu Shi Zheng Zong has miswritten characters in this sentence: 'slander' is written with a wrong character, and 'Ying and Prince E (Yao)' is written as a garbled string; the translation follows the old commentary. The old commentary also has two cases, the fourth line attacking Output and the Self controlling Output; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong keeps only the second.

units.title: 国朝·子伤君位，隋杨广有弑父之心（旧注：本宫子孙带杀旺动克害世爻，是太子有篡位之兆，如隋杨广弑父自立）

rule.yi: 本宫的子孙带着凶煞、旺相发动、克害世爻，是太子有篡位的征兆，就像隋朝的杨广弑杀父亲、自立为皇帝。
rule.en: If the Output of the home palace carries a baleful spirit, is thriving and moves, and controls and harms the Self, the crown prince shows signs of usurping the throne, like Yang Guang of Sui who killed his father and set himself up as emperor.

zh: 子伤君位，隋杨广有弑父之心。
yi: 子孙伤克君位，就像隋朝的杨广有杀父的心思。
en: If Output injures the ruler's place, it is like Yang Guang of Sui who had it in his heart to kill his father.

zh: 本宫子孙，带杀旺动，克害世爻，乃太子有篡位之兆。
如隋杨广弑父，自立为帝。
yi: 本宫的子孙带着凶煞、旺相发动，克害世爻，是太子有篡位的征兆。
就像隋朝的杨广弑父，自立为皇帝。
en: If the Output of the home palace carries a baleful spirit, is thriving and moves, and controls and harms the Self, it is a sign that the crown prince will usurp the throne.
It is like Yang Guang of Sui who killed his father and set himself up as emperor.

zh: 本宫子孙旺动克害世爻，乃太子有篡位之兆，如隋杨广弑父自立为帝。
yi: 本宫的子孙旺相发动、克害世爻，是太子有篡位的征兆，就像隋朝的杨广弑父自立为皇帝。
en: If the Output of the home palace is thriving and moves and controls and harms the Self, it is a sign that the crown prince will usurp the throne, like Yang Guang of Sui who killed his father and set himself up as emperor.

note.yi: 旧注比卜筮正宗多「带杀」一个条件。
note.en: The old commentary has one more condition than the Bu Shi Zheng Zong: 'carrying a baleful spirit'.

units.title: 国朝·一卦无孙，宋仁宗有绝嗣之叹（旧注：卦中无子孙，或子孙休囚、动入墓绝空死，必是国无太子，如宋仁宗无子而叹）

rule.yi: 卦里没有子孙，或者子孙休囚，又发动落入墓、绝、空、死，必定是国家没有太子，就像宋仁宗没有儿子而叹息。
rule.en: If there is no Output in the hexagram, or Output is resting or trapped and moves into tomb, extinction, Void or death, the state has no crown prince, like Emperor Renzong of Song who sighed because he had no son.

zh: 一卦无孙，宋仁宗有绝嗣之叹，
yi: 整个卦里没有子孙，就像宋仁宗有绝了后嗣的叹息，
en: If there is no Output in the whole hexagram, it is like Emperor Renzong of Song sighing that his line would end,

zh: 卦中无子孙，或子孙休囚，动入墓绝空死，必是国无太子。
如宋仁宗无子而叹。
yi: 卦中没有子孙，或者子孙休囚，发动后落入墓、绝、空、死，必定是国家没有太子。
就像宋仁宗没有儿子而叹息。
en: If there is no Output in the hexagram, or Output is resting or trapped and moves into tomb, extinction, Void or death, the state surely has no crown prince.
It is like Emperor Renzong of Song who sighed because he had no son.

zh: 卦中无子孙或子孙休囚动入墓绝，必是国无太子，如宋仁宗无子而叹。
yi: 卦中没有子孙，或者子孙休囚、发动落入墓、绝，必定是国家没有太子，就像宋仁宗没有儿子而叹息。
en: If there is no Output in the hexagram, or Output is resting or trapped and moves into tomb or extinction, the state surely has no crown prince, like Emperor Renzong of Song who sighed because he had no son.

units.title: 国朝·四爻克子，秦扶苏中赵高之谋（旧注：四爻为臣位，旺动伤克本宫子孙，如秦太子扶苏被赵高矫诏赐死）

rule.yi: 第四爻是臣位。它旺相发动、伤克本宫的子孙（太子），就像秦朝的太子扶苏被赵高假传诏书赐死。
rule.en: The fourth line is the ministers' seat. If it is thriving and moves and injures and controls the Output of the home palace (the crown prince), it is like Fusu, the crown prince of Qin, who was ordered to die by Zhao Gao's forged edict.

zh: 四爻克子，秦扶苏中赵高之谋。
yi: 第四爻克子孙，就像秦朝的扶苏中了赵高的计谋。
en: If the fourth line controls Output, it is like Fusu of Qin falling into Zhao Gao's scheme.

zh: 四爻，乃臣位。
若旺动，伤克本宫子孙，则如秦太子扶苏，被赵高矫诏赐死。
yi: 第四爻是臣子的位置。
如果它旺相发动，伤克本宫的子孙，就像秦朝的太子扶苏，被赵高假传诏书赐死。
en: The fourth line is the ministers' seat.
If it is thriving and moves and injures and controls the Output of the home palace, it is like Fusu, the crown prince of Qin, who was ordered to die by Zhao Gao's forged edict.

zh: 四爻乃臣位，若旺动伤克本宫子孙，则如秦太子扶苏被赵高矫诏赐死。
yi: 第四爻是臣子的位置，如果旺相发动、伤克本宫的子孙，就像秦朝的太子扶苏被赵高假传诏书赐死。
en: The fourth line is the ministers' seat; if it is thriving and moves and injures and controls the Output of the home palace, it is like Fusu, the crown prince of Qin, who was ordered to die by Zhao Gao's forged edict.

units.title: 国朝·身值动官，唐太宗禁庭蹀血（旧注：世身持官带杀旺动，必至杀克兄弟、兄弟不相容，如唐太宗伏兵玄武门射死建成元吉）

rule.yi: 世爻或卦身持着官鬼，带着凶煞、旺相发动，必定发展到杀害兄弟，是兄弟不能相容的征兆，就像唐太宗在玄武门埋伏士兵，射死建成、元吉，血流满了宫中。
rule.en: If the Self or the Body holds Pressure with a baleful spirit and is thriving and moving, it ends in killing brothers; it is a sign that brothers cannot tolerate each other, like Taizong of Tang, who set troops in ambush at the Xuanwu Gate and shot Jiancheng and Yuanji dead, so that blood flowed in the palace court.

zh: 身值动官，唐太宗禁庭蹀血；
yi: 卦身遇到发动的官，就像唐太宗在禁宫的庭院里血流遍地；
en: If the Body meets a moving Pressure line, it is like Taizong of Tang with blood trampled in the palace court;

zh: 世身持官，带杀旺动，必至杀克兄弟，乃兄弟必不相容之兆。
如唐太宗，伏兵玄武门，将建成，元吉射死，血流禁庭，而被军马蹀践也。
yi: 世爻或卦身持着官，带着凶煞、旺相发动，必定发展到杀害兄弟，这是兄弟必定不能相容的征兆。
就像唐太宗，在玄武门埋伏士兵，把建成、元吉射死，血流满了禁宫的庭院，被军马践踏。
en: If the Self or the Body holds Pressure, carries a baleful spirit and is thriving and moving, it surely comes to the killing of brothers, a sign that brothers cannot tolerate each other.
It is like Taizong of Tang, who set troops in ambush at the Xuanwu Gate, shot Jiancheng and Yuanji dead, and the blood flowed in the palace court and was trampled by the soldiers' horses.

zh: 身世持官带杀旺动，必至杀克兄弟，如唐太宗伏兵玄武门，射死建臣元吉，血流禁庭马蹀践也。
yi: 世爻、卦身持着官，带着凶煞、旺相发动，必定发展到杀害兄弟，就像唐太宗在玄武门埋伏士兵，射死建成、元吉，血流满了宫廷、被马践踏。
en: If the Self and the Body hold Pressure, carry a baleful spirit and are thriving and moving, it surely comes to the killing of brothers, like Taizong of Tang who set troops in ambush at the Xuanwu Gate and shot Jiancheng and Yuanji dead, so that blood flowed in the palace court and was trampled by the horses.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗此处写「射死建臣元吉」，「建臣」应是旧注的「建成」，译文按旧注读。
note.en: The Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes 'shot dead Jianchen Yuanji' here; 'Jianchen' is read as the 'Jiancheng' of the old commentary, and the translation follows the old commentary.

units.title: 国朝·世安空弟，周泰伯让国逃荆（旧注：世持兄弟空亡、与应相生合、更有吉神动克，是兄弟推让天位之象，如泰伯托为采药逃往荆蛮、让位季历）

rule.yi: 世爻持着落空亡的兄弟，和应爻相生相合，又有吉神发动来克，是兄弟之间互相推让天子之位的象，就像泰伯假托采药逃到荆蛮，把位置让给季历。
rule.en: If the Self holds a Void Peer line, generating or combining with the Other, and an auspicious spirit also moves to control, it is the image of brothers yielding the throne to one another, like Taibo, who on the pretext of gathering herbs fled to the Jing barbarians and gave the succession to Jili.

zh: 世安空弟，周泰伯让国逃荆。
yi: 世爻安在落空的兄弟上，就像周朝的泰伯让国、逃到荆地。
en: If the Self sits on a Void brother, it is like Taibo of Zhou who yielded the state and fled to Jing.

zh: 世持兄弟空亡，与应相生合，更有吉神动克，必是兄弟推让天位之象。
如周泰伯托为采药，逃之荆蛮，让位季历也。
yi: 世爻持着兄弟且落空亡，和应爻相生相合，又有吉神发动来克，必定是兄弟互相推让天子之位的象。
就像周朝的泰伯假托去采药，逃到荆蛮之地，把位置让给季历。
en: If the Self holds the Peer line and it is Void, generating or combining with the Other, and an auspicious spirit also moves to control, it is surely the image of brothers yielding the throne to one another.
It is like Taibo of Zhou, who on the pretext of gathering herbs fled to the Jing and Man peoples and yielded the throne to Jili.

zh: 世持空弟，与应爻合，有吉神动克，是兄弟推让天位之象，如周泰伯托为采药逃之荆，蛮让位季历也。
yi: 世爻持着落空的兄弟，和应爻相合，有吉神发动来克，是兄弟互相推让天子之位的象，就像周朝的泰伯假托去采药，逃到荆蛮之地，把位置让给季历。
en: If the Self holds a Void brother and combines with the Other, and an auspicious spirit moves to control, it is the image of brothers yielding the throne, like Taibo of Zhou who on the pretext of gathering herbs fled to the Jing and Man peoples and yielded the throne to Jili.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗原文「逃之荆，蛮让位季历」中间的逗号是标点之误，应连读为「荆蛮」，译文按此读。
note.en: In the Bu Shi Zheng Zong the comma in 'fled to Jing, Man yielded the place to Jili' is a punctuation slip; 'Jing and Man' is to be read together, and the translation reads it so.

units.title: 国朝·凶神生合世神，玄宗信林甫之佞（旧注：鬼杀发动生合世爻，必是佞臣阿谀、人君信任，如唐玄宗信任李林甫十九年，养成天下大乱）

rule.yi: 官鬼、凶煞发动来生合世爻，必定是奸佞的臣子阿谀奉承、国君信任他，就像唐玄宗信任李林甫十九年，养成了天下大乱。
rule.en: If a Pressure line or a baleful spirit moves to generate or combine with the Self, a treacherous minister is surely flattering the ruler and the ruler trusts him, like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang who trusted Li Linfu for nineteen years and bred great disorder in the realm.

zh: 凶神生合世神，玄宗信林甫之佞；
yi: 凶神生合世神，就像唐玄宗相信李林甫的奸佞；
en: If a baleful spirit generates or combines with the Self, it is like Xuanzong believing in the treachery of Li Linfu;

zh: 若鬼杀动，生合世爻，必是佞臣阿谀，人君信任。
如唐玄宗，信任李林甫一十九年，养成天下大乱。
yi: 如果官鬼、凶煞发动，生合世爻，必定是奸佞的臣子阿谀奉承，国君信任他们。
就像唐玄宗，信任李林甫一十九年，养成了天下大乱。
en: If a Pressure line or a baleful spirit moves and generates or combines with the Self, a treacherous minister is surely flattering the ruler, and the ruler trusts him.
It is like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, who trusted Li Linfu for nineteen years and bred great disorder in the realm.

zh: 若鬼煞动来生合世爻，必是佞臣阿谀，人君信任，如唐玄宗信任李林甫一十九年，养成天下大乱。
yi: 如果官鬼、凶煞发动来生合世爻，必定是奸佞的臣子阿谀奉承，国君信任他，就像唐玄宗信任李林甫一十九年，养成了天下大乱。
en: If a Pressure line or a baleful spirit moves to generate or combine with the Self, a treacherous minister is surely flattering the ruler and the ruler trusts him, like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang who trusted Li Linfu for nineteen years and bred great disorder in the realm.

units.title: 国朝·君位克伤四位，商纣害比干之忠（旧注：四爻为臣，持财子而被世爻动克，是犯颜直谏之臣遇剖心之主，如比干尽忠被纣王所杀）

rule.yi: 第四爻是臣。四爻持着妻财或子孙，却被世爻发动来克，是敢于冒犯君主、当面直谏的臣子，遇到了剖人心的君主，就像比干尽忠而被商纣王杀害。
rule.en: The fourth line is the minister. If the fourth line holds Wealth or Output and is moved and controlled by the Self, it is a minister who dares to offend the ruler's face with plain advice meeting a ruler who cuts out hearts, like Bi Gan, who was loyal to the end and was put to death by King Zhou of Shang.

zh: 君位克伤四位，商纣害比干之忠。
yi: 君位克伤第四爻，就像商纣王加害比干的忠心。
en: If the ruler's place controls and injures the fourth place, it is like King Zhou of Shang harming the loyalty of Bi Gan.

zh: 四爻为臣。
持财子，而被世爻动克，必犯颜之臣，遭剖心之主。
有如比干之尽忠，而被纣王之诛也。
yi: 第四爻是臣。
它持着财、子孙，却被世爻发动来克，必定是敢于冒犯君主颜面直谏的臣子，遇上了剖人心的君主。
就像比干尽忠，却被纣王杀害。
en: The fourth line is the minister.
If it holds Wealth or Output and is moved and controlled by the Self, he is surely a minister who dares to offend the ruler's face and meets a ruler who cuts out hearts.
It is like Bi Gan, who was loyal to the end and was put to death by King Zhou.

zh: 四爻为臣，持财子而被君爻克伤，如比干之尽忠，而被纣王之诛也。
yi: 第四爻是臣，持着财、子孙而被君爻克伤，就像比干尽忠，却被纣王杀害。
en: The fourth line is the minister; if it holds Wealth or Output and is controlled and injured by the ruler's line, it is like Bi Gan, who was loyal to the end and was put to death by King Zhou.

note.yi: 旧注说四爻「被世爻动克」，卜筮正宗说「被君爻克伤」；前面分派各爻时，君爻是太岁，世爻不是，两处用的不是同一爻。
note.en: The old commentary says the fourth line is 'moved and controlled by the Self', the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says it is 'controlled and injured by the ruler's line'; in the assignment of the lines the ruler's line is Tai Sui and not the Self, so the two do not use the same line.

units.title: 国朝·离宫变入坎宫带凶杀，而徽钦亡身于漠北（旧注：卦中大象皆凶、世应克害刑冲，或世动入死墓空绝，是国君遭患死亡之兆；离南坎北，离化坎由南入北，如宋徽钦二宗被金所掳老死沙漠）

rule.yi: 整个卦象都凶，世爻、应爻互相克害刑冲，或者世爻发动入死、墓、空、绝，是国君遭灾死亡的征兆；离宫变入坎宫，离是南方、坎是北方，由南入北，就像宋朝的徽宗、钦宗被金人掳走，囚在五国城，老死在北方的沙漠地带。
rule.en: If the whole image is bad, the Self and the Other control, harm, punish and clash with each other, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is a sign that the ruler will meet calamity and die; a Li-palace hexagram turning into a Kan-palace hexagram goes from south to north (Li is south, Kan is north), like the Song emperors Huizong and Qinzong, who were carried off by the Jin, held at Wuguo City, and grew old and died in the desert land.

zh: 离宫变入坎宫带凶杀，而徽钦亡身于漠北；
yi: 离宫变入坎宫，又带着凶煞，就像徽宗、钦宗身亡在北方的沙漠；
en: If a Li-palace hexagram turns into a Kan-palace hexagram and carries baleful spirits, it is like Huizong and Qinzong who lost their lives in the northern desert;

zh: 卦中大象皆凶，世应克害刑冲，或世动入死墓空绝，必是国君遭患，死亡之兆。
离乃南方，坎乃北方。
离化坎，乃南入北。
故如宋之徽钦二宗，被金兀术所掳，幽于五国城，卒老死于沙漠之地。
yi: 卦中整体的象都是凶的，世爻、应爻互相克害刑冲，或者世爻发动入死、墓、空、绝，必定是国君遭祸患、死亡的征兆。
离是南方，坎是北方。
离变化为坎，就是从南入北。
所以就像宋朝的徽宗、钦宗二帝，被金兀术掳走，囚禁在五国城，最后老死在沙漠地带。
en: If the whole image in the hexagram is bad, and the Self and the Other control, harm, punish and clash with each other, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is surely a sign that the ruler will meet calamity and death.
Li is the south and Kan is the north.
Li turning into Kan is going from south into north.
So it was with the two Song emperors Huizong and Qinzong, who were taken captive by the Jin general Wuzhu, held at Wuguo City, and in the end grew old and died in the desert land.

zh: 卦象凶，世又遭克，或动入墓绝，乃死亡之兆。
离南坎北，离化坎由南入北，如宋徽钦被金所掳，死于漠北。
yi: 卦象凶，世爻又被克，或者发动入墓、绝，是死亡的征兆。
离在南、坎在北，离变化为坎是从南入北，就像宋朝徽宗、钦宗被金掳走，死在北方的沙漠。
en: If the image is bad, the Self is also controlled, or it moves into tomb or extinction, it is a sign of death.
Li is south and Kan is north; Li turning into Kan goes from south into north, as when Huizong and Qinzong of Song were carried off by the Jin and died in the northern desert.

units.title: 国朝·乾象化为巽象有吉曜，而孙刘鼎足于东南（旧注：乾宫变巽宫，大象皆吉，当如刘备孙权建国东南，与魏三足鼎立）

rule.yi: 乾宫变巽宫，又有吉曜，就像刘备、孙权在东南建国，和魏国三足鼎立。
rule.en: A Qian-palace hexagram turning into a Xun-palace hexagram, with an auspicious star, is like Liu Bei and Sun Quan founding states in the south-east and standing with Wei like the three legs of a tripod.

zh: 乾象化为巽象有吉曜，而孙刘鼎足于东南。
yi: 乾的象变成巽的象，又有吉曜，孙权、刘备就在东南鼎足而立。
en: If the Qian image turns into the Xun image and has an auspicious star, then Sun and Liu stand like the legs of a tripod in the south-east.

zh: 乾宫变巽宫，大象皆吉。
当如刘先主，吴孙权，建国东南，与魏三足鼎立也。
yi: 乾宫变成巽宫，整个卦象都吉。
就像刘先主、吴国的孙权，在东南建国，和魏国三足鼎立。
en: If a Qian-palace hexagram turns into a Xun-palace hexagram, the whole image is auspicious.
It is like the First Ruler Liu and Sun Quan of Wu, who founded states in the south-east and stood with Wei like the three legs of a tripod.

zh: 乾变巽宫，大象皆凶，若有吉曜，如刘玄德与吴魏三国鼎足而立也。
yi: 乾变成巽宫，整个卦象都凶，如果有吉曜，就像刘玄德和吴、魏三国鼎足而立。
en: If Qian turns into the Xun palace and the whole image is bad but there is an auspicious star, it is like Liu Xuande standing with Wu and Wei as three kingdoms like the legs of a tripod.

dispute.yi: 旧注说「乾宫变巽宫，大象皆吉」，卜筮正宗写成「大象皆凶，若有吉曜」。一个说这个象本身吉，一个说象凶、要有吉曜才成。书里没有判哪一个对。
dispute.en: The old commentary says 'when a Qian-palace hexagram turns into a Xun-palace hexagram, the whole image is auspicious'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes 'the whole image is bad, but if there is an auspicious star'. One says the image itself is good, the other that the image is bad and only an auspicious star makes it work. The books do not decide which is right.
